text: Fleeing [her stepfather's advances|wrong|sexual violation], the orphaned student Sam moves into [an isolated boarding house in North Jakarta|trigger|making a new home], once a batik factory, whose second floor must stay locked. She is warned about the chair before [a Javanese mirror in her room|images|mirrors and glass] and learns durmo, a chanted Javanese poem said to summon the Kuntilanak, a female ghost living in the weeping fig outside. Whenever Sam [falls into a trance and chants it|rules|calling it brings it], someone who has crossed her dies.
